title: BenchEntrant
description: bench.entrant@1 (compare-arena-ecosystem.md, 2026-11-13): what competes in a match. KIND says which: a MODEL alone (on the neutral harness), a HARNESS alone (rated over a fixed model panel), an AGENT (a harness with a model and its settings, the way people run it; CONFIG_HASH or BLUEPRINT pins the settings) or a PRODUCT (a builder people use whole). ID is the entrant's stable name: model:<model>, harness:<harness>@<version>, agent:<harness>+<model>#<config hash>, product:<slug>. Every rating and every number on a page names the entrant's kind, so a model's score is never shown without its harness.

family.description: The model family, so the matchmaker can avoid pairing two of one family.

id.description: claude-code, codex, opencode, goose, gemini-cli, aider, openvibe (the engine's own loop), ov-bare (the neutral harness) …

config_hash.description: An agent's settings (tools, effort, prompts) hashed, so a change of settings is a new entrant.

blueprint.description: An agent made as agents.blueprint@1: the blueprint and its version.

owner.description: Who entered it: the network's own catalogue, a person's agent or a community machine.
